Switch in v2 template setup. Turning it on opens and applies advanced OAuth settings; turning it off uses automatic OAuth configuration.

messages.text: {connectionType, select, tunnel {Select a tunnel or enter a valid tunnel ID to review OAuth settings.} other {Enter a valid server URL to review OAuth settings.}}
messages.description: Supporting text below the disabled advanced OAuth switch in the native custom plugin setup dialog. Tells workspace administrators how to complete their selected connection method before reviewing local OAuth settings. connectionType is tunnel for a secure tunnel connection, otherwise a direct server URL. Opening settings discovers metadata for that target.
Return to the Connection step while preserving the custom plugin setup.

messages.text: These client settings have not been confirmed with this server.
messages.description: Help text below the registration method in native template Advanced OAuth settings when discovery has not succeeded. A template may declare optional credentials, dynamic registration (DCR), or a client metadata document (CIMD), but that does not establish the current server's support or preconfigured client availability.
Explicitly checks MCP server settings using the entered custom headers before continuing to Authentication.
Status while checking the MCP connection before the Authentication step.

messages.text: Choose the authentication settings for this server.
messages.description: Validation shown when v2 template creation needs an API key header scheme or a supported OAuth token authentication method before submission.
Inline error at the OAuth client secret field after Create when the selected client authentication method requires secret or private-key material for an explicitly supplied client ID.

messages.text: Enter an OAuth client ID to customize scopes or OpenID Connect settings.
messages.description: Validation shown when v2 template creation has explicit scope or OpenID Connect choices that cannot reuse a preconfigured OAuth client.
Placeholder for the complete server endpoint after selecting Custom URL in v2 plugin template creation.

messages.text: If a selected tool does not define OAuth scope tags, ChatGPT requests base scopes and default scopes.
messages.description: Explains when default scopes are requested in template OAuth advanced settings.

messages.text: The template's scope or resource defaults differ from this server. The template defaults are retained for you to review.
messages.description: Notice in native template OAuth settings when declared scope or resource defaults differ from discovery. These editable defaults are preserved, unlike server-authoritative endpoint and capability fields.

messages.text: {unsupported, select, true {This server does not advertise OAuth settings. Check the server URL and its authentication requirements.} other {Could not load OAuth settings. Check your connection settings and try again.}}
messages.description: OAuth discovery error in v2 MCP template setup beside a separate Retry button. Unsupported means the server explicitly reported no OAuth configuration. For a request failure, suggest checking the form's connection settings before retrying the metadata read; this does not mean the settings are necessarily incorrect. Neither variant creates a plugin or automatically changes authentication.

messages.text: Enter a unique valid name and value for each custom header.
messages.description: Validation error in native template setup. Discovery waits for bounded custom header names and values without duplicate names or line breaks.

messages.text: These settings are unverified. A successful retry replaces endpoint URLs and OpenID Connect settings with server values.
messages.description: Notice above editable OAuth settings before successful discovery, including after failure. Warns that retrying discovery replaces local endpoint URLs and OpenID Connect settings; it does not validate or save manual settings.

messages.text: Some template or edited authentication options are not supported by this server. Review the supported settings below.
messages.description: Warning when fresh native template OAuth discovery cannot support a declared or edited client mode or token authentication method. Unsupported choices are replaced in the effective form with supported server options.
Retry button after native template OAuth metadata discovery fails. Repeats only the metadata read.

messages.text: OAuth discovery replaced these settings: {fields}. The current server values below are read-only.
messages.description: Notice naming endpoint and OpenID Connect fields whose template or manual values were replaced by successful OAuth discovery. fields is a localized list of field labels, never values or secrets. The newly displayed fields are read-only, including settings the server did not return.
Continue from validated Connection settings to Authentication without creating a plugin.
Placeholder for the OAuth client secret or private-key credentials in native template setup. Whether it is required depends on the chosen client authentication method.

messages.text: Enter the OAuth endpoints from your provider. These settings have not been verified with this server. See the <link>Apps SDK auth docs</link>.
messages.description: Helper text above manually editable OAuth endpoints in native template setup before successful discovery. Entered values remain local settings and do not establish server capabilities. The link opens OAuth documentation.

messages.text: {field, select, name {Custom name is required.} description {Description is required.} other {Connection is required. Enter a valid MCP server URL or select a tunnel.}}
messages.description: Inline validation error in the personal or workspace-admin MCP template setup dialog after attempting to continue or create with incomplete settings. The field selector is name, description, or connection; connection requires a valid server URL or a selected tunnel.

messages.text: These settings use the MCP server\u2019s OAuth information and available client configuration. Supported scopes describe available permissions; requested scopes are determined when you connect. ChatGPT provides the setup URLs. Turn on Use advanced settings to make changes.
messages.description: Explanation above the automatic Authentication summary in template-based custom plugin setup. Scope labels distinguish configured defaults, advertised supported permissions, and configured base scopes. A supported scope list is not a promise of the permissions requested or granted when connecting. ChatGPT supplies callback and client metadata URLs. Direct administrators to advanced settings to customize the connection. Shown after successful discovery when advanced overrides are off.

Label for configured scopes added by automatic OAuth setup, shown separately when default scopes are unknown. These scopes come from the connection configuration and must not be presented as the server's advertised supported scopes.

messages.text: Dynamic Client Registration (DCR) may be used if CIMD is unavailable during connection.
messages.description: Explains that automatic setup can fall back to DCR when CIMD cannot satisfy client authentication requirements.

messages.text: If your provider requires an allowlist, allow the CIMD URL and callback URL above.
messages.description: Setup guidance for administrators whose OAuth provider restricts allowed client metadata documents and redirect URLs.

messages.text: {kind, select, cimd {Copy CIMD URL} other {Copy callback URL}}
messages.description: Tooltip and accessible label for the button beside an automatically selected OAuth setup URL. CIMD means Client Identifier Metadata Document; callback is the OAuth redirect URL.
Label for the OAuth client method preferred by automatic setup. The connection may fall back to another supported method.

messages.text: {method, select, USER_DEFINED {Configured OAuth client} EXISTING {Existing OAuth client (verified when you connect)} CIMD {Client Identifier Metadata Document (CIMD)} DCR {Dynamic Client Registration (DCR)} other {Client details required in Advanced OAuth settings}}
messages.description: Automatically selected OAuth client method. A configured client was found by discovery. Existing client means the template permits reuse, which is verified during connection. When no automatic method is available, the administrator must supply client details.

messages.text: {known, select, true {No default scopes specified} other {Determined when you connect}}
messages.description: Scope value in the automatic Authentication summary when explicit defaults and known base scopes are empty, or when no scope information is available. Known means an explicitly empty default list, not a guarantee that the final connection requests no permissions.

messages.text: {kind, select, defaults {Default OAuth scopes} supported {Supported OAuth scopes} other {OAuth scopes}}
messages.description: Scope row label in the automatic Authentication summary for custom plugin setup. Defaults are explicitly configured scopes plus any known base scopes. Supported scopes are advertised capabilities, not a selected client's permissions. The generic label is used when neither list is known. Keep each label short.

messages.text: Final scopes may change during client registration or include OpenID Connect scopes when you connect.
messages.description: Explains that a pre-creation scope preview cannot include a future dynamic registration response or all connection-time identity scopes.
Label above a copyable OAuth setup URL in the automatic authentication summary.
A template has not supplied this authentication setting. This does not mean no authentication is required.
Short option in the MCP server URL dropdown in the custom plugin setup dialog. Lets workspace administrators enter a complete endpoint URL instead of filling in a suggested URL format.
Label for the dropdown that selects a suggested URL format or a custom server URL in v2 plugin template creation.
Label above the server URL whose inline placeholders are editable in v2 plugin template creation.
Sensitive OAuth client secret supplied by the MCP provider; kept only in this form until creation.

messages.text: Automatic: use the OAuth client\u2019s scopes when available, otherwise the server\u2019s supported scopes. Select or enter scopes to override.
messages.description: Help text for unspecified default OAuth application scopes during MCP setup. The client scopes take precedence over the server's advertised scopes. Editing this field creates an explicit default, including an empty list when cleared.
Add a custom header when the exact source gate allows it.
Custom API key request header name.
Close the custom plugin setup dialog.
Accessible label for copying a provider setup value.
Copies the entire template server URL, including static text and every entered value. Disabled until all placeholders are filled.

messages.text: Couldn't copy the URL. Try again.
messages.description: Error when clipboard access fails while copying a template server URL.
Create the app instance using the current native provider template.
Close the successful app creation result.

messages.text: Your app was created, but we couldn't load its plugin page. Try refreshing again to continue setup.
messages.description: A read-only lookup failed after app creation succeeded. Refresh never repeats creation.

messages.text: Your app was created. Its plugin page is still becoming available. Refresh to continue setup.
messages.description: Keep the successful creation result when canonical plugin lookup is not ready; never repeat creation.
Look up the newly created plugin without retrying its creation.
The template instance was created successfully.
Placeholder in the full endpoint input after a workspace administrator selects Custom URL in the plugin setup dialog. Enter the complete server URL instead of filling in a suggested format.
Label above the optional description field when creating an MCP template instance. The parenthetical text communicates the maximum character count for this field.
Name for a source-gated custom MCP header.
Secret value for a source-gated custom MCP header.

messages.text: {error, select, size {Choose a PNG file no larger than 5 MB.} other {Choose a valid PNG image.}}
messages.description: Validation error for an optional instance icon. An image that fails browser decoding falls back to the template icon.

messages.text: Could not read the instance icon. Select it again and try again.
messages.description: Local error when reading an optional PNG icon before v2 plugin instance creation. No creation request has been sent.
Discards the optional icon selected for the new instance and restores the template's existing icon.
Accessible label and tooltip for the button over the template icon. Selects a replacement for this plugin instance only.

messages.text: PNG only. Best results at 256 x 256 px or larger. Max file size: 5 MB
messages.description: Icon upload guidance shared by instance editing and template instance overrides: PNG format, recommended dimensions, and the five mebibyte upload limit.
Documentation link below Client registration in template setup. Preserve the link tag around the document title.
Dropdown option for using the administrator's OAuth client credentials in template setup.

messages.text: See the <link>Apps SDK tool descriptor docs</link>.
messages.description: Documentation link below Scopes in template setup. Preserve the link tag around the document title.

messages.text: Couldn't complete app setup. No creation request was sent. Check your settings, re-enter any cleared credentials, and try again.
messages.description: Creation was proven not dispatched by the server. The administrator can correct setup, re-enter credentials cleared on submission, and explicitly submit again.

messages.text: A previous creation attempt may have succeeded. Review your apps and private drafts in ChatGPT before trying again. A new attempt may create a duplicate.
messages.description: A retained creation marker blocks another attempt without claiming whether the prior write completed.
Opens the GitHub private key PEM file picker.

messages.text: Couldn't read the private key file. Upload a single .pem file up to 16 KB, or paste the key below.

Status after loading a GitHub private key file into the form.

messages.text: Drag and drop a .pem file here
messages.description: Prompt for uploading the GitHub App private key PEM file.
Remove a custom header from this unsaved template setup.

messages.text: I checked my apps; try again
messages.description: Acknowledges review without sending a creation request. The user must separately submit a new attempt, which may create a duplicate.
Accessible label for the MCP server URL in template setup.
Button label that reveals optional OAuth client settings for an app template that has a managed OAuth client.

messages.text: Enter your organization's OAuth client details and provider settings. This creates a workspace-specific draft app that can be published afterward.

messages.text: Enter your organization's provider settings. This creates a workspace-specific draft app that can be published afterward.
messages.description: Explains service template setup when provider OAuth credentials are optional.
Creates an unpublished service template app in this workspace.

messages.text: Leave this as-is to use the template defaults, or override with your own requested scopes.
